hero.title3: With the Same Precision We Apply to Every Radiology Interpretation
hero.description: Welcome to Accurad Teleradiology Solutions. This page explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our website, in accordance with the sensitive nature of our medical teleradiology services.

information.title: Information We Collect
information.intro: We may collect the following information when you use our website:

items.organization: Hospital, Radiology Center, or Healthcare Organization (if applicable)
items.contactInfo: Any information you provide through the contact form
items.attachments: Any files or documents you choose to upload through the contact form (if this feature is available)

information.technicalIntro: We may also automatically collect certain technical information, including:

usage.title: How We Use Information
usage.intro: The information we collect may be used for the following purposes:

items.reply: Responding to inquiries and contact requests
items.communication: Communicating with hospitals, radiology centers, and potential clients
items.security: Maintaining website security and preventing misuse
items.legal: Complying with applicable legal requirements when necessary

contactForm.title: Contact Form
contactForm.description: When you use the contact form on our website, the information you submit is sent directly to the official email address of Accurad Teleradiology Solutions using the EmailJS service.
contactForm.note: Our website does not store contact form submissions in a website database. The information is used solely to respond to your inquiries or communicate with you regarding the services you requested.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Our website may use cookies to improve your browsing experience and analyze website performance.
cookies.note: You can disable cookies through your browser settings. However, some website features may not function properly.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: Our website may use certain third-party services to enhance the user experience or analyze website performance, including:

items.emailjs: EmailJS for sending contact form messages
items.analytics: Google Analytics (if implemented in the future)

thirdParty.note: These services are governed by their own privacy policies. Accurad Teleradiology Solutions is not responsible for the privacy practices of such third parties.

security.title: Information Security
security.paragraph1: We are committed to taking appropriate measures to protect the information submitted through our website against unauthorized access, use, modification, or disclosure.
security.paragraph2: Although we strive to maintain the highest level of security, no method of data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

medicalPrivacy.title: Medical Data Confidentiality
medicalPrivacy.paragraph: Accurad Teleradiology Solutions is committed to maintaining the confidentiality of all medical information and patient-related data.
medicalPrivacy.note: When using any of our medical or teleradiology services, all medical information is handled according to the highest standards of confidentiality and professionalism and is used solely for providing the requested medical services.

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.paragraph1: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.
sharing.paragraph2: Certain information may only be disclosed if required by law or when necessary to protect the rights of the company or the users of our website.

externalLinks.title: External Links
externalLinks.paragraph1: Our website may contain links to external websites.
externalLinks.paragraph2: This Privacy Policy does not apply to those websites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before using their services.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.intro: You have the right at any time to:

items.view: Request access to the personal information you have provided
items.edit: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
items.delete: Request deletion of your personal information whenever applicable
items.contact: Contact us to inquire about how your information is being used

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.paragraph1: This website is intended for hospitals, radiology centers, physicians, and healthcare organizations and is not directed toward children.
children.paragraph2: We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13.

updates.title: Privacy Policy Updates
updates.paragraph1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect legal, technical, or operational changes.
updates.paragraph2: Any updates will be published on this page together with the latest revision date.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.paragraph1: If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or the way we handle your information, please feel free to contact us.
